thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Fncall request surge detected in hosted-east-1. 5xxs trending up, 95th p99 latency x4. Auto-mitigation candidate: muzzle_fncall gating. Escalating to runtime on-call.

Sam W: saw it. loading the dashboard now. are we seeing a tenant blast or broad traffic?

Maria K: looks broad — ~12% of requests are fncall-heavy, spans free and standard tiers. A bunch of high-frequency agents too.

Jia L: paging in. I'm on-call. can we get a quick impact summary for customers? who is affected?

Sam W: initial scan: majority internal tests + several small external customers. No enterprise SLAs flagged yet. Token cost spike is causing autoscaler thrash.

ops-bot: Auto mitigation suggestion: set runtime flag `muzzle_fncall=true` for tier in [free, burst] and `structured_output_reduction=aggressive` for those requests. Rollout plan: immediate global flip with 1m cooldown.

Sam W: let's not flip global immediately. propose phased: 1) disable fncall for free tier, 2) for burst tags (tenant.metadata.burst=true) apply structured-output -> plain fallback, 3) monitor 5m.

Jia L: agree phased. I'll own the toggle. Sam, can you prepare the admin command? paste below when ready.

Sam W: admin CLI snippet:

```
# mute function/tool calling for free tier
redwood-admin runtime toggle --name muzzle_fncall --value on --filter "tier:free" --reason "live mitigation 2154321000"

# shrink structured output for burst tenants
redwood-admin runtime set-config --key structured_output_mode --value plain --filter "tags:burst" --reason "live mitigation 2154321000"
```

Kevin P: +1. Also trim max_tokens_for_structured=64 for affected buckets so large JSONs don't tie up runtimes.

Maria K: customer-impact checklist: 1) Free-tier users will see tool-calls dropped and JSON outputs simplified to text. 2) Apps relying on fncall-driven webhooks may get 502s or fallback messages. 3) Support team notified to expect ~30 tickets from devs testing agents.

Jia L: executing step 1 now. will post when done.

(19s later)

Jia L: done — `muzzle_fncall` ON for tier:free. ops-bot confirmed change deployed to edge proxies. Monitoring.

Sam W: metrics updating — fncall qps down 68% in free tier, overall p95 latency improving. Still seeing pressure from a handful of burst tenants.

Jia L: moving to step 2 for burst-tagged tenants. applying `structured_output_mode=plain` and `max_tokens_for_structured=64` for tags:burst. will leave a 30s gap to observe.

ops-bot: Rollout status: step2 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete across regions. No config errors.

Maria K: outreach: I'm drafting a short post to support templates: 1) what changed 2) expected behavior 3) workaround. Will post to #support and customer status page after handoff.

Kevin P: note for developers: if you rely on functioncall parsing, add server-side fallback for plain text responses — we may keep this enforced for up to 2h depending on stabilization.

Alex R: are we gating any billing or quota changes? we might need temporary per-tenant rate caps while we heal.

Sam W: yes. I'll set a soft quota cap on top 10 noisy tenants: reduce rps limit by 40% and add a 10s backoff header for clients.

Jia L: doing caps now. applying to tenant IDs in the noisy list. will annotate in audit log with "mitigation-2154321000".

(40s later)

Jia L: caps applied. p95 across cluster down 28%, error rate stabilizing.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations active: muzzle_fncall (free), structured_output plain (burst), per-tenant RPS caps on noisy tenants. Alert moving to maintenance state. Continue to monitor.

Maria K: support message ready, posting now. tagging enterprise-svcs to confirm no downstream hooks broken for paid customers.

Sam W: handing off to next on-call. Jia — take any remaining tasks and own the post-mitigation review. I'll follow up with logs and patch notes.

Jia L: taking handoff. I'll watch for 30m and then start a short incident write-up. Thanks all.

Alex R: add to postmortem: why fncall-heavy workloads hit autoscaler, plus recommendations for graceful degradation (prefer local fallback, smaller structured outputs, client retry hints).

Sam W: noted. will capture kernel/runtime metrics and KV cache contention traces.

Jia L: incident acknowledged. closing this thread after stabilization updates. :handshake:

incident-bot: Incident state: acknowledged -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-215432. Ping @eng-oncall for any escalation.
